'''Mark Schaffer''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 41 from Hampton, Va. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

He helped run Sci-Con in Virginia Beach and got Decipher to hold a Regional qualifier there. He ran weekly demos, a league and two to three tournaments a month in Hampton Roads. He was Gold 41 in the Tatooine region, from Hampton, VA.<ref name="decsq-prof">[http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/players/schaffermark.html Star Wars CCG Squadrons: Gold 41 profile], decipher.com. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001119082200/http://decipher.com:80/volunteers/squadrons/players/schaffermark.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.
